$comment: Tool registry shared by the scenario scripts. Names are the scenario vocabulary; the real registry may prefix connector tools (mcp__<server>__<tool>) and the runner maps them. sideEffect / targetKind follow docs/05 §3.1; approvalKind follows docs/04 §4 approvals.kind; receiptKind follows the docs/05 §3.11 receipt example.

tools.name: gmail.draft
tools.note: A draft stays in the owner's mailbox: write, not destructive (docs/05 §3.1).

tools.name: gmail.forward
tools.note: Listed so tool_not_called can name it; the scripts never call it.

tools.name: library.save
tools.note: Psyche's own store: `none` per docs/05 §3.1 (architecture §4.3 lists Library items under write; see README decisions).

tools.name: calendar.freebusy
tools.note: Busy intervals only, no titles or descriptions, so the result is not tainting.

tools.name: reminders.create
tools.note: A Psyche reminder (Upcoming + notification kind reminder), not Apple Reminders.

tools.name: shop.compare
tools.note: Searches every allowlisted store through the browser; results are page text (untrusted).

tools.name: shop.add_to_cart
tools.note: A cart is reversible and private to the owner's session: write (docs/05 §3.1).

tools.name: shop.checkout_handoff
tools.note: Commits to pay once payment exists (G12): financial, once only, device-only. In M2 it re-reads the cart and stops; nothing is paid.

tools.name: shop.pay_with_link
tools.note: G12: the hand-off's cart check, then Stripe Link pays (test mode in scenarios): the vault's PaymentBroker re-checks the dispatched once-only purchase approval, Link writes a one-time card to a 0600 file, the browser fill core types it into the merchant's card form. The model sees brand / last4 and the order number only.

tools.name: travel.search_flights
tools.note: Fares from the owner's allowlisted airlines (fixture sites); offer text is untrusted page content.

tools.name: travel.hold_fare
tools.note: V4 / G12: the airline authorizes the Stripe Link one-time card for the fare without charging it (the vault's hold). Once only, device-only; the card shows flights, traveler, fare class, total and the funding card's last4.

tools.name: travel.ticket_hold
tools.note: Ticketing captures the held authorization (the vault's capture); a second once-only purchase card.

tools.name: travel.cancel_booking
tools.note: Cancelling inside the airline's free window refunds the capture (the vault's refund).
